distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Chongqing, Jiangxi, Yunnan and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepts Taiwan occurrence, with records from Ilan (Fu Shan) and Nantou (Hui Son and Neimoupu).

host_note: No host is promoted from the Smith record. Beaver & Liu (2010) characterizes the species as polyphagous but enumerates no host taxon in the curated field; broad polyphagy remains contextual.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Blandfordium minutus (Blandford, 1894).

nomenclature_note: Smith & Cognato (2026) transferred this taxon to Blandfordium minutus. Earlier treatments used Planiculus minutus (Beaver & Liu, 2010) and Euwallacea minutus (Smith et al., 2020). The current integrated taxonomic backbone identifies Blandfordium minutus (Blandford, 1894) as the accepted combination. The earlier mainland China and Taiwan occurrence evidence is retained.
